anomalies.expected: VREF+_FCC should connect to FCC2 pin 20 (VREF+) so the ADC reference is filtered and biased; PH1 should remain an oscillator/GPIO pin and not carry the VREF+ filter.
anomalies.impact: The STM32H753 VREF+ pin is left floating, so ADC measurements are not referenced correctly; the PH1 oscillator/GPIO pin is loaded by the VREF filter, which can also disturb HSE operation.

anomalies.observed: 2.2 uF capacitors are connected from the MCU HSE oscillator pins PH0/PH1 to ground: C80 on FCC2 PH0, C89 on NAVC2 PH1, and C59 on NAVC2 PH0.
anomalies.expected: HSE crystal load capacitors on PH0/PH1 should be in the low-picofarad range (typically ~10 pF), not 2.2 uF; 2.2 uF would prevent the crystal oscillator from starting or operating correctly.
anomalies.impact: The HSE crystal oscillators on both MCUs are heavily loaded and may fail to start, leaving the MCUs without their intended high-speed external clock.

anomalies.expected: Decoupling or VCAP capacitors should have both terminals connected between the intended rail/node and ground; a floating capacitor terminal provides no decoupling and indicates an open connection.
